sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a chic twist to your jewelry collection with this silver-plated adjustable open ring, designed with a delicate floral American Diamond motif and a sparkling solitaire-style stone. A perfect blend of elegance and trendiness, this ring is ideal for daily wear, parties, or gifting.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Silver-plated finish
- Stone Type: American Diamond (AD)
- Design: Open ring with floral & solitaire accents
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits comfortably on most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Suitable for daily wear, parties, and gifting
sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Silver-Plated Adjustable Floral Open AD Ring
